integrity: The proof is analytic. Clarkson's exact sub-Hilbert inequality supplies the only nontrivial upper bound, and explicit two-coordinate vectors attain every asserted value. No numerical experiment, finite enumeration, or external certificate is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the real sequence spaces \(\ell_p(I)\) with \(|I|\ge2\), the parameters \(\kappa,\tau>0\), and the specific constant \(\mathcal T_1\). It does not classify all equality cases or extend automatically to arbitrary Banach spaces. An equivalent formula under substantially different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact sub-Hilbert branch of the two-parameter geometric-mean constant on real \(\ell_p\)
